title: Controlled Articular Rotations (CARs)
protocol: Slow controlled head circle within available pain-free active motion while the rest of the body stays still; sitting and standing positions are discussed; smaller pain-free arc is an easier option.
variant: Seated stable chair, relaxed hands, both soles fixed. One continuous eight-second circle: flexion, right rotation/side bend, extension, left rotation/side bend, flexion. No hand assistance.
limitations: Angles and8second cycle are illustrative, not a prescribed source dose or universal maximum range. One direction shown. Source makes broad health claims; candidate only depicts movement and does not reproduce treatment claims.
